name: Ponchi
slug: A stronghold guard who will relocate to the tavern.
description: Ponchi is one of the guards associated with the stronghold.

log.summary: Ponchi is named as one of the guards who will evacuate the stronghold and relocate to the tavern.
notes: Is named as one of the guards who will evacuate the stronghold and relocate to the tavern.

log.summary: Ponchi is identified as Ord's roommate, remembered as a little gold person who makes something involving gold. The name was misheard as Banshee and Archie before the table settled on Ponchi.
notes: Ord's roommate. Remembered as a little gold person who makes something involving gold. The name was misheard as Banshee and Archie before the table landed on Ponchi.

log.summary: Ponchi is a raccoon-like Tanooki who insists that Tanooki are sentient individuals. He is learning to cook from Mahali and seems to enjoy it, helping prepare dinner by cutting vegetables; gems sometimes turn up in the buns he bakes, the largest about thumb-sized. He rooms with Ord in the basement bunkhouse below the stronghold, where Moxie also lives. After the guards' hot tub was removed because its steam warped the bunk beds, Ponchi began digging a new one, only a couple of inches deep, in the middle of Ord's quarters before abandoning it, leaving behind a pickaxe, a large hammer, a maul, and a metal chisel. He found Moxie and made it a roommate; Moxie repeats his name, and Ponchi sent Ord with food to feed it. He carries a small gourd-like flask that he drinks from after meals.
